root_cause: HTTPAdapter.send translates SSL and read-timeout exceptions but bare-reraises other urllib3 HTTPError subclasses. Consequently, directly raised TimeoutError, ConnectTimeoutError, and DecodeError can escape the Requests exception boundary. This establishes a translation gap, not the exact reported proxy or decoding reproduction; normal response streaming already translates DecodeError.
